market: Observability / APM sold to engineering teams
buyer: VP Engineering, Director of Platform, SRE lead, CTO at small companies
notes: Technical buyer who can check every claim against a system they know better than you. Mechanism beats benefit. Never claim open source is cheaper: it is a different cost structure and they have already priced the engineer-hours.

mechanism: {product} is OpenTelemetry-native, so the instrumentation stays yours and the backend stops being a rebuild.
{product} reads OTLP directly. No agent in your code, so leaving later costs a config change, not a re-instrumentation.
{product} bills on telemetry volume, not hosts or seats. A different shape of bill, not a smaller one.

triggers.name: otel
triggers.why: already on OpenTelemetry: instrumentation is portable, backend is a choice

triggers.name: incumbent
triggers.why: names an incumbent: there is a bill, an owner and a renewal date
